ios.desc:
Hey there! Ever wondered where all those hours disappear to? Juno is your friendly time companion that helps you uncover the mystery - no judgment, just gentle awareness!

Think of it like having a fitness tracker for your day - except instead of counting steps, we're helping you make every hour count.

Whether you're:
• A student trying to find more study-Netflix balance
• Someone who loses track of time (we've all been there!)
• Just curious about where your day goes
• Looking to make small, positive changes

Juno's got your back! No pressure, no complicated systems - just a friendly companion helping you understand your time better.

Why You'll Love Juno:
• Super simple tracking (seriously, two taps and you're done!)
• Deep & easy to digest insights that actually make sense
• Your day, your categories - customize everything
• Zero pressure, all progress

Level Up with Premium:
• Track unlimited activities (because life doesn't fit in a box)
• Unlock detailed insights (the fun kind, not the boring ones)
• Make it truly yours with advanced customization
• Watch your progress unfold with beautiful trends

Ready to discover your hidden hours? Let's make time tracking actually fun!

P.S. Yes, you can totally count "staring at the ceiling" as an activity. We don't judge!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Juno – Time tracking that works like a fitness tracker for your day

quotes.text:
Hi HN! I built Juno because I was frustrated with existing time trackers being too complex and bloated. I wanted something that would help people understand their time the same way a fitness tracker helps understand physical activity.

What makes Juno different:
- Focuses on awareness rather than micromanagement
- Simple one-tap tracking interface
- Shows patterns and insights without being judgmental

I'd love feedback particularly on:
1. The onboarding experience
2. The visualization of time data
3. Any friction points you encounter

This is my first major app release after years doing backend dev work. Looking forward to your thoughts!
